method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (13 Oct 2026): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO/laws.sg, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 13 Oct 2026: OECD Global Minimum Tax / GloBE Model Rules pages and search for post-11 Sep releases. Latest substantive package remains 11 Sep 2026 Administrative Guidance / GIR / Full Legislative Review. No new OECD Pillar Two releases since the 12 Oct refresh.
coverage.HK: Checked 13 Oct 2026: IRD global minimum tax / HKMTT page (Phase 2 of the Pillar Two Portal still stated as Q4 2026). Secondary Deloitte alert on Pillar Two vs enhanced R&D deduction (9 Oct) is analysis of existing rules plus the already-catalogued Sept 2026 GIR; not a new primary IRD development. No new official Pillar Two items.
coverage.SG: Checked 13 Oct 2026: IRAS GloBE/DTT page, MOF newsroom, SSO Bill No. 22/2026, and laws.sg. SSO still hosts Bill No. 22/2026 only (no Acts-Supp assent/gazette page for a Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026). laws.sg shows 'As enacted' metadata (page stamp Updated 13 Oct 2026) but without an SSO Acts-Supp or Gazette confirmation this is not treated as verified enactment. Nothing new since the 6 Oct parliamentary passage already catalogued.
coverage.JP: Checked 13 Oct 2026: NTA 新着情報 and the 趣旨説明 page for the 7 Aug 2026 circular (still published; already catalogued as 9 Oct 2026). No further Pillar Two administrative guidance or GIR schema updates beyond items already in updates.json.
